Biogeochemical Cycles - Carbon, Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Sulfur

sections.text: While energy flows through ecosystems and is lost as heat, nutrients cycle. The same carbon atom might be in a plant, soil, atmosphere, ocean, and fossil fuel over millions of years. Human activities have dramatically accelerated most biogeochemical cycles — creating imbalances that drive climate change, eutrophication, ozone depletion, and ocean acidification.
